task: Audio-to-target-speaker CLAN/CHAT analysis; this training stage improves transcript utterances, not ASR or diarization
user_priority: Minimize final language-measure error; 90% boundary F1 is diagnostic, not the objective
reference_unit: Human CLAN/CHAT utterances, explicitly confirmed by user
sealed_data: Public test and all 10 original participants are evaluation only. No examples, error review, training, adaptation or choice from them in this round. Historical benchmark use is disclosed.
primary_selection: Lowest corpus-balanced mean participant mean recording APE, equally averaged across utterance count, surface MLUw and population length SD; zero reference denominators unavailable, never zero-filled. Equal corpus weighting prevents OCSC size hiding NYU error. Lexical errors and boundary F1 reported separately.
tie_break: Exact objective ties: higher validation boundary F1, then fewer parameters, then lexical name
candidates_scope: Bounded before development; no final score can expand or revise this round

training.views: Original training paragraphs and one seeded position crop per paragraph; no gold-cut geometry
training.metric_loss: CE plus mean squared relative boundary-count deviation per owned valid window; denominator gold positive count + 1. Weight 1 for metric candidates, zero for context control. Training labels only.
training.corruption: Metric candidates randomly replace 5% non-special input subtokens with UNK during training only. This is synthetic robustness, not claimed to reproduce real ASR errors.
training.balancing: Metric candidates sample training windows with equal expected mass for each public corpus; context control uses natural corpus mix
training.initialization: deberta_metric continues validation-selected deberta_context for at most 3 epochs; other candidates start official pretrained encoders
training.averaging: Also validate equal parameter average of final three epochs; fixed class argmax for all candidates

deployment: Preserve earlier production model and workbook routing until selection; deploy only validation choice. Never change deployment from private final results.
metric_policy: Existing source-word preservation, filler/unintelligibility eligibility and metric formulas unchanged. No posthoc count forcing or gold lengths in inference.
user_clarifications: Primary goal is low downstream metric error and human CLAN/CHAT utterance agreement, not a 90% F1 target.
Audio work explicitly deferred by user; current round is transcript paragraphs only.
Human utterance formatting is removed before prediction; references remain separate.

amendments.reason: User explicitly requested independent automatic sentence cues during public-only development; final groups remain sealed
amendments.specification: Continue selected public-validation DeBERTa; expand rule embedding to four states (automatic spaCy sentence plus clause bits). Same metric objective, 3-epoch metric/noise/balancing setup. Features recomputed from plain words; never gold punctuation.

amendments.reason: Primary-source Batchalign research motivates transferring an encoder already trained on MICASE utterance labels, rather than only written-language encoders. Public train/validation development only; no final access or new participant data.
amendments.specification: Initialize base encoder from pinned public CHATUtterance checkpoint; new shared word-gap/rule head; same six-epoch metric-loss/noise/corpus-balancing protocol. Official model card attributes pretraining to MICASE, not OCSC/NYU. This is domain adaptation, not a full Batchalign replication.

amendments.reason: Metric-first objective includes utterance-length dispersion, so test a train-only differentiable span second-moment auxiliary loss as well as count supervision. No new final outcomes accessed.
amendments.specification: Initialize from selected public-validation DeBERTa context; 3 epochs, same count/noise/balance settings plus equally weighted squared relative second-moment discrepancy over contiguous known-gap regions. Expected span squared-length sum computed exactly from Bernoulli gap probabilities in log space. This is an internal training experiment, not a claimed reproduction of a published method; boundary CE remains. No inference constraints or gold lengths.

inference_device: Auto MPS when available, CPU fallback; no backend selected from final scores
development_audit_scope: Four permitted training/validation originals compared with actual CLAN; original coding/eligibility and normalized surface-word profiles differ. This is an accounting-scope audit, not a new model accuracy result. Evidence is in improved_calculator_checks.json: metric_round_development_chat_policy_audit.

superseded_development.reason: Confirmed on public train/validation: pylangacq audible retains &= non-speech event codes; applying WORD directly invented event descriptions as words. Interrupted unfinished jobs for data integrity, not final outcomes. Historical source data and prior scores preserved.

Reference audit against official CHAT manual and installed CLAN verified explicit continuation joining. Stopped public-only development before final access to repair reference unit labels as well as non-speech words; groups/raw sources unchanged.

preparation: Remove &= non-speech event annotations before word extraction. Preserve genuinely spoken repetitions/fillers/fragments. Reconstruct references from spoken-word rows only; unchanged child groups and original raw source hashes. Public test preparation occurs only after selection.
reference_unit_policy: Spoken-word CHAT units: remove &= non-speech event descriptions, omit rows with no spoken words, join explicit incompletion-plus-comma and forced transcription-break continuations as documented and checked against actual CLAN. Codes define reference labels only, never model inputs.

development_markup_audit.scope: All child rows from train/validation source files only; no final files

preparation_note: Input and reference repairs were determined from public train/validation and official CHAT/CLAN rules before final access. Earlier interrupted candidate scores are superseded, not compared as current results. Re-evaluate frozen incumbent on identical corrected test input after selection.

handoff.operational_status: Resumed by user; incomplete context candidate restarted from initialization with partial bundle/history preserved.

interruption_restarts.reason: User authorized continuation in new chat. Optimizer/scheduler/RNG were not saved; restart from the same pinned initialization, seed and frozen public development settings. This is not an exact batch resume.

analysis_reporting.scope: Reporting and uncertainty only; no model, loss, candidate, selection-objective or routing changes
analysis_reporting.specification: Report before/after final composite objective, all individual participant errors, and 10,000 paired participant-cluster bootstrap intervals stratified by corpus for the declared composite. Existing per-metric median intervals remain separate. Zero/absent denominators follow the registered availability policy. Literature comparisons distinguish percent agreement, consistency ICC, WER, F1 and language-measure APE. Defined before final access.

compute_handling.reason: Observed low free system memory and slower later epochs during local sequential GPU training; no training failure or final-data access
compute_handling.change: Release unused MPS allocator cache before validation and after epoch bookkeeping for subsequently started candidates. Live model/optimizer tensors and RNG/data/loss/selection settings are unchanged. Already running RoBERTa and completed candidates are not restarted.

bundle_serialization_repair.scope: Synthetic words and public validation only; final cohorts remain sealed
bundle_serialization_repair.diagnosis: Generic PreTrainedTokenizerFast default add_prefix_space=False overwrote serialized RoBERTa ByteLevel=True. Synthetic word IDs changed after bundle reload, while explicit True exactly restored training IDs.
bundle_serialization_repair.remedy: Preserve add_prefix_space from serialized pre-tokenizer; architecture, weights, loss and training-epoch selection are unchanged. Revalidate unchanged selected RoBERTa bundle on frozen public validation, then restore complete status. Subsequent training refuses completion if reloaded objective/F1 differs from selected in-memory history.

deadline_amendment.reason: User explicitly required finishing within five minutes; remaining training interrupted before final access. Select only among completed public-validation candidates.
deadline_amendment.private_reference_policy: Use frozen aligned boundary labels; human word-stream metrics remain direct human-reference measures. Exact span scoring unavailable when no exact gold boundaries are supplied.

completion_limits: The new selected pipeline has now been run and audited on all 74 recording-condition outputs (37 ASR and 37 corrected recordings), including exact agreement with all 14 frozen private predictions, source-word preservation, 17 TAALED comparisons per recording and actual CLAN agreement within displayed precision. The separate public-test downstream lexical comparison stage remains pending; do not infer it from these original-cohort checks.
